entry.title: Profit-08 0.1.3
entry.summary: Rebuilt against the updated mpc-vst-plugins wrapper: **Q-Links now move parameters on track edit → automation** (a plain host write no longer makes MPC rebuild its parameter screen; sd88me/mpc-vst-plugins#486). No other changes. `*-mpc-armv7.zip` is for Gen1 MPCs and the Force; `*-mpc-aarch64.zip` is the Gen2 build (MPC OS 3.x), tested offline only. Settings and your own files in the plugin's data folders are kept on upgrade.

entry.title: Profit-08 0.1.0
entry.summary: Eight-voice, two-layer analog-style synthesizer for Akai MPC OS standalone devices (Force, MPC Live / One / X / Key), modelled on a classic programmable poly: layers A and B as normal, stack and split, unison, a gated sequencer and an arpeggiator per layer, two analog-style oscillators and a resonant 2/4-pole lowpass per voice, three envelopes, four LFOs and the modulation matrix. Its program is the instrument's own 384 bytes, so its program and bank SysEx dumps load unchanged. Native MPC screen
